# Mnemoverse — Persistent Memory API for AI Agents

> One memory. Every AI tool. Write once, recall anywhere.

## What is Mnemoverse

Mnemoverse is hosted memory for AI agents that learns from outcomes, with shared rooms. It stores preferences, decisions, lessons, and context, and makes them available in Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, and any MCP client. Each tool connects to the same account in its own way: a browser sign-in (OAuth) or an API key.

Not a vector database: rating a recalled memory (memory_feedback) changes how it ranks next time. Consolidation (merging similar memories) is designed in and currently switched off on the hosted service.

## API

Base URL: https://core.mnemoverse.com/api/v1
Auth: X-Api-Key header (or Authorization: Bearer)
Get your free key: https://console.mnemoverse.com

### Endpoints

POST /memory/write    — Store a memory (content, concepts[], domain)
POST /memory/read     — Search memories (query, top_k, domain)
POST /memory/feedback — Rate usefulness (atom_ids[], outcome -1..1)
GET  /memory/stats    — Memory statistics (total atoms, domains, etc.)
POST /memory/write-batch  — Store up to 500 memories at once
POST /memory/read-batch   — Batch query up to 50 queries
POST /memory/consolidate  — switched off on the hosted service (returns 503)

### Quick Example (Python)

pip install mnemoverse

from mnemoverse import MnemoClient
client = MnemoClient(api_key="mk_live_YOUR_KEY")
client.write("User prefers Railway for deploys", concepts=["deploy", "railway"])
results = client.read("how does the user deploy?")

### Quick Example (curl)

curl -X POST https://core.mnemoverse.com/api/v1/memory/write \
  -H "X-Api-Key: mk_live_YOUR_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"content": "User prefers Railway", "concepts": ["deploy", "railway"]}'

curl -X POST https://core.mnemoverse.com/api/v1/memory/read \
  -H "X-Api-Key: mk_live_YOUR_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query": "how does the user deploy?", "top_k": 5}'

## Setup by Tool

### Claude Code (one command)

Keyless (browser sign-in): add the hosted server, then run /mcp in a Claude Code session, select mnemoverse and choose Authenticate.

claude mcp add -s user --transport http mnemoverse https://mcp.mnemoverse.com/mcp

With an API key (local server):

claude mcp add mnemoverse \
  -e MNEMOVERSE_API_KEY=mk_live_YOUR_KEY \
  -- npx -y @mnemoverse/mcp-memory-server

### Cursor

Keyless: open https://cursor.com/install-mcp?name=mnemoverse&config=eyJ1cmwiOiJodHRwczovL21jcC5tbmVtb3ZlcnNlLmNvbS9tY3AifQ== ("Add to Cursor"), then click Connect next to mnemoverse in Cursor Settings → Tools & MCPs. Works in every Cursor window, including the Agents Window. The VS Code extension below also runs in Cursor's editor windows and offers the same step.

With an API key (~/.cursor/mcp.json):

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "mnemoverse": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@mnemoverse/mcp-memory-server"],
      "env": { "MNEMOVERSE_API_KEY": "mk_live_YOUR_KEY" }
    }
  }
}

### VS Code

Keyless: install the Mnemoverse Agent Memory extension (https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=Mnemoverse.mnemoverse-vscode, also on Open VSX), then run "Mnemoverse: Sign In". It registers the server with GitHub Copilot agent mode; no JSON to edit. Or add the hosted server and let VS Code run the OAuth sign-in:

{
  "servers": {
    "mnemoverse": { "type": "http", "url": "https://mcp.mnemoverse.com/mcp" }
  }
}

With an API key (.vscode/mcp.json):

{
  "servers": {
    "mnemoverse": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@mnemoverse/mcp-memory-server"],
      "env": { "MNEMOVERSE_API_KEY": "mk_live_YOUR_KEY" }
    }
  }
}

### Claude Desktop (~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json)

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "mnemoverse": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@mnemoverse/mcp-memory-server"],
      "env": { "MNEMOVERSE_API_KEY": "mk_live_YOUR_KEY" }
    }
  }
}

### Windsurf (~/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json)

Same format as Cursor config above.

### ChatGPT

MCP connector with OAuth (developer mode; availability and write access depend on the ChatGPT plan): https://mcp.mnemoverse.com/mcp — see https://mnemoverse.com/docs/api/chatgpt

Custom GPT with Actions (API key):

Import OpenAPI spec from: https://mnemoverse.com/docs/openapi-gpt.yaml
Auth type: API Key, header name: X-Api-Key, value: mk_live_YOUR_KEY
Manual setup required — see https://mnemoverse.com/docs/api/chatgpt

### Any tool (REST API)

Use the curl examples above. Any tool that can make HTTP requests can use Mnemoverse.

## MCP Server Tools

After setup, your AI gets 10 tools:

memory_write          — Store a preference, decision, lesson, or project fact
memory_read           — Search memories by natural-language query
memory_list_recent    — List the newest memories first, no query needed
memory_feedback       — Report whether a recalled memory helped; it ranks better or worse next time
memory_stats          — How many memories, which domains, average valence and importance
memory_create_room    — Create a shared memory room (Beta)
memory_invite_to_room — Invite someone to a room you own
memory_join_room      — Join a room with an invite code
memory_list_rooms     — List the rooms you own or joined
vault_list            — List your Vault secrets by alias; the value is never returned

## Pricing

Free    $0/mo    1,000 queries/day    10,000 atoms    60 req/min
Pro     $29/mo   50,000 queries/day   500,000 atoms   600 req/min
Team    $149/mo  500,000 queries/day  5,000,000 atoms  3,000 req/min

Enterprise — custom pricing, unlimited, SSO/SAML, dedicated infrastructure.
